members.name: banking_routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about? Pick the single option that best matches the customer's main request.

criteria.age_limit: minimum age / age requirements to open an account or use the service
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using or topping up with Apple Pay, Google Pay or a phone/watch wallet
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs the card can be used at, ATM availability
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up or asking about automatic / auto top-up
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: cheque or cash deposit not showing in balance yet
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add a beneficiary / payee, beneficiary not allowed to receive
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (changed mind, wrong account)
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring, replacing an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, can I use it at a merchant
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet, tracking the card
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery date or country
criteria.card_linking: adding / linking a card to the app, finding a card in the app
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: charged a fee for a card payment
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: unknown or unrecognised charge or card payment they did not make
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: complaint that the exchange rate applied to their purchase or payment was wrong
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: fee charged for ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: cash withdrawal they did not make
criteria.change_pin: changing or updating the card PIN
criteria.compromised_card: card details compromised, suspicious activity, someone may have used the card
criteria.country_support: which countries the bank operates in / supports
criteria.declined_card_payment: card declined or rejected at the moment of paying at a shop or online
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits on how many disposable virtual cards or uses
criteria.edit_personal_details: changing name, address or personal details
criteria.exchange_charge: general question about fees or cost of currency exchange (is there a fee, how much, fee structure)
criteria.exchange_overcharged: complaint that a currency exchange they already made cost more than it should or its charges were wrong
criteria.exchange_rate: general question about what exchange rate is used or how rates are set (not a complaint about a rate already applied)
criteria.exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an extra charge on the statement they want explained, e.g. a small amount charged in error
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.order_physical_card: ordering a physical card, card delivery options
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot app passcode, can't log in with passcode
criteria.pending_card_payment: card payment, or a payment not said to be a transfer, still pending or taking long to go through
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or locked after wrong attempts
criteria.pin_not_received: has not received their PIN yet / where to get the PIN for a new card
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: a merchant refund not showing up
criteria.request_refund: wants a refund for a purchase
criteria.reverted_card_payment: a card payment that was cancelled, reverted, came back, or was returned to the account (e.g. why would my card payment be cancelled?)
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards (Visa, Amex...) and currencies are supported
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.top_up_reverted: top-up reverted / money disappeared after top-up
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up using a card
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: charged twice / duplicate charge for one purchase
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: fee charged on a transfer, or recipient received less than the amount sent
criteria.transfer_into_account: transferring money into the account from elsewhere
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: recipient did not receive the transfer
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying or showing the source of funds: where the money in their account came from
criteria.verify_top_up: top-up verification code / why top-up needs verifying
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less cash than requested
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
